That the report entitled 2027 Fees and Charges dated December 7, 2026, be received; and,
That the attached Fees and Charges Schedules “A”, “B”, “C”, “D”, “E”, “F”, “G”, “H”, “I”, “J”, and “M”, marked as Recreation and Culture Services, Corporate Services, Public Works, Engineering Services, Legislative Services – General Fees, Departments General, Legislative Services – Licensing, Building Permit, Planning Act Processing Fees, and Parks, be approved and adopted by by-law; and,
That the attached Fees and Charges are increasing within the delegated authority and therefore Schedules “K”, “L”, marked as Water and Wastewater Rates and Stormwater Rates be approved and adopted by by-law; and,
That the fee adjustments come into full force and effect as of January 1, 2027; and,
That Staff be authorized and directed to do all things necessary to give effect to this resolution.

That the report entitled Administrative Updates to the Committee Administration Policy dated December 7, 2026 be received; and,
That the Committee Public Appointment Policy and the Committee Administration Policy be repealed and replaced with the attached Committee Administration Policy (Attachment 1); and,
That the Terms of Reference for all Town Committees and Boards be amended to include the Inclusion Statement as set out in (Attachment 2); and,
That Staff be authorized and directed to do all things necessary to give effect to this resolution.
